title: The Private Life of Genghis Khan
author: Douglas Adams
note: conf=0.9; Standalone comic short story (1986), co-written by Douglas Adams and Graham Chapman from a sketch for the 1975 pilot "Out of the Trees"; EPUB metadata credits Adams alone. Published in The Utterly Utterly Merry Comic Relief Christmas Book and included in some editions of The Salmon of Doubt; also posted on douglasadams.com. ISFDB lists it as a standalone SHORTFICTION title with no series. It features a cameo by Wowbagger the Infinitely Prolonged from Life, the Universe and Everything, which links it loosely to the Hitchhiker's Guide universe, but no source assigns it a position in that (or any) numbered series, so reported as standalone.
